description: C4, a departed player's loaded transports, on three peers, in both slot orders. Apply on one joiner (J) after `tools/mp_lobby.sh --map 'Show Down'` with three instances: k and l each load a TXCOM1 at (1400, 2000) and (3800, 2000), clear of the three start positions. k's ATLAS is listed first, so it takes the lower slot and kill-all reaches its passenger through the transport's cargo loop; l's passenger is listed first, so kill-all reaches it first and its own destructor detaches it. Then freeze J's TotalA.exe (kill -STOP its pid): the other peers raise TIMEOUT.GUI, whose REJECT runs the engine's own player removal 0x452CC0, and so kill-all's non-local branch for J's army. Run it on one peer first (REJECT, or `+kill <J's seat>` with `tacli switches <i> cheats=on`), then read the other before it rejects: both of J's passengers must still be carried there (+0x86 set) and its wire 0a count unchanged, since inside kill-all neither detach of a departed player's unit broadcasts its 0x0A. Its REJECT then logs 'a keyed passenger detached inside kill-all' for k's and 'a carried self-destruct: TXCOM1 -> TX_BLAST_S' for both. Content: tools/datakeys_fixture.py into every instance's gamedir.
